name: zanker-product-discovery
description: Discover product goals, users, jobs and evidence before redesigning a screen.

workflow.instruction: Inspect product docs, language strings, route names and existing analytics definitions without assuming these prove user motivations.
Produce facts, hypotheses and unknowns separately; identify primary user task and success metric.
Ask only questions whose answers materially change user experience or risk.
Record a concise product.context.json and reference sources.

outputs: Primary user outcome and evidence confidence
acceptance: Never assert user research happened unless it did
Distinguish user needs from stakeholder requests
fallback: Use explicit hypotheses and document missing evidence.
